task: Remove a photo's background and save a transparent PNG

x-display.title: Remove photo backgrounds
x-display.summary: Turn a photo into a transparent PNG on your computer.
x-display.description:
Prepare product photos, portraits or objects for another design. Use the transparent result to place your subject against a different background.

The result is a cutout you can open in your usual image editor. Adding a replacement background or arranging several cutouts happens there.

packaging_note: Uses rembg's CPU inference API and only its u2net model.

inputs.what: a photo with a foreground subject

outputs.what: the original subject on a transparent background

known_issues: Uses the CPU and u2net. An image with no distinguishable subject can fail the transparency check.
